reviews.comment: Love it! Works great, love the LCD screen and the customization of it. Also, its cheap!
reviews.author: Hunter Kushion

reviews.title: Great aio cooler
reviews.comment: This cooler works way better than I expected I’m coming from a custom loop to this aio cooler and it works way better the pump is only at 30% power and my idle temps are at 22c every time i turn it on and works better than the custom loop I had the pump was always set to 100% non stop and the idle temps was about 30c. Will highly recommend and can’t beat the price either and the display screen is awesome you can customize it any way you want
reviews.author: Steven M.

reviews.title: Great AIO with big LCD display
reviews.comment: This was super easy to install into my custom pc build. The noise level is low once you figure out how to manage fan speeds to change based off of CPU (central processing unit) temps and not motherboard temps. The screen is a lot bigger than I thought it’d be and it’s awesome to be able to customize it with photos, gifs, etc. The software is a little hard to navigate but overall, this was a great AIO (all-in-one) that keeps my pc cool and at a great price.
reviews.author: RevanTheSavior

reviews.title: great company that stands behind their products
reviews.comment: worked great for months, stopped cooling and pump failed, but thermalright was very quick and responsive to send a brand new unit out. irs quiet, and does a great job cooking my 7800x3d
